Title: [LSJ]: The rack, burning a vampire and influencing back in a duplicate vampire

Messages.Author: Jeroen du Chatinier
Messages.Body:
Quick question that popped up last game I would like a 'writ of LSJ'
on. I have searched but I couldn't find anything specific on it.

My prey has one Salbatore Bokkengro in play and one in her
uncontrolled region. She plays the rack for it. I put a Judgement:
Camarilla Segregation in play. During her minion phase, she burns
Salbatore to burn the Judgement: Camarilla Segregation. Now, if she
influences back in the Salbatore Bokkengro from her uncontrolled
region, does he gain control of the Rack because he is the same
vampire as the one that was chosen when she put the Rack in play?

A ruling or reference would help us out with this.

Thank you in advance,

Jeroen du Chatinier

Messages.Author: Peter D Bakija
Messages.Body:
Jeroen du Chatinier wrote:

> My prey has one Salbatore Bokkengro in play and one in her
> uncontrolled region. She plays the rack for it.

You can't play The Rack on an uncontrolled vampire. You can't play Master
cards on uncontrolled vampires unless they specifically say "put this card
on an uncontrolled vampire".

I put a Judgement:
> Camarilla Segregation in play. During her minion phase, she burns
> Salbatore to burn the Judgement: Camarilla Segregation. Now, if she
> influences back in the Salbatore Bokkengro from her uncontrolled
> region, does he gain control of the Rack because he is the same
> vampire as the one that was chosen when she put the Rack in play?

Moot.

daniel frey wrote:
> Since the Rack has the odd aspect of being targetted at a vampire vs.
> being put on a vampire, does the Rack cost one pool to play on a secure
> havened vampire?

No. Similarly, you could play a contract on a minion and name an
Assamite who had a Secure Haven without paying a pool. (Although
you would have to pay a pool if the minion who you put the
Contract on has a Secure Haven, of course, not that it would
accomplish much, since you couldn't use it to attack the
minion until the Haven was burned.)
